title: DeepFly3D, a deep learning-based approach for 3D limb and appendage tracking in tethered, adult Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, '3D pose permits robust unsupervised behavioral classification'; Figs. 4-5; Figure 5-video 1; Methods 'Optogenetic stimulation experiments'
quote: we optically activated CsChrimson (Klapoetke et al., 2014) to elicit backward walking in MDN>CsChrimson animals
mapping_basis: The paper's name MDN is itself a MANC type name in type_list.csv; the line MDN-1-Gal4 (VT44845-DBD; VT50660-AD) is listed as MDN-1 -> MDN in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 617 nm LED aimed at dorsal thorax; 9 s trials: 2 s baseline, 5 s illumination, 2 s off (embedding used 4 s of stimulation); five trials per fly
sensory_condition: tethered on air-supported spherical treadmill, dark chamber, 850 nm IR illumination
n_flies_note: n = 6 flies, 29 trials (Fig. 4/5 legends); controls MDN-GAL4/+ n = 4 flies
notes: Methods paper using MDN activation as a known behaviour. Backward walking coded yes for all three leg pairs (PROTOCOL 3). Fig. 5 3D joint-angle map region for MDN is enriched for backward walking (Figure 5-video 4); videos not downloaded. Line specificity is not discussed in this paper.

title: DeepFly3D, a deep learning-based approach for 3D limb and appendage tracking in tethered, adult Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, '3D pose permits robust unsupervised behavioral classification'; Figs. 4-5; Figure 5-video 2; Methods 'Drosophila transgenic lines'
quote: or antennal grooming in aDN>CsChrimson animals
mapping_basis: The paper calls the line aDN-Gal4 (R76F12-AD; R18C11-DBD); driver_lines.csv maps R76F12-AD;R18C11-DBD to aDN2 = DNfl023, but another kit row for the same enhancer pair (aDN2-spGAL4-2) is UNMAPPED (DNg127), and the paper's name 'aDN' does not say which aDN, so medium.
stimulation: 617 nm LED aimed at dorsal thorax; 9 s trials: 2 s baseline, 5 s illumination, 2 s off (embedding used 4 s of stimulation); five trials per fly
sensory_condition: tethered on air-supported spherical treadmill, dark chamber, 850 nm IR illumination
n_flies_note: n = 6 flies, 30 trials (Fig. 4/5 legends); controls aDN-GAL4/+ n = 4 flies
notes: Antennal grooming means front legs yes (PROTOCOL 3). The paper does not describe what the middle and hind legs do, so they are coded unclear. Fig. 5 legend: the map region for aDN>CsChrimson is enriched for antennal grooming (Figure 5-video 5); videos not downloaded.

title: Synaptic gradients transform object location to action.
source_locator: Main text 'Neural control of looming escape direction'; Fig. 1e-i; Extended Data Fig. 1e-h; Supplementary Table 1-2
quote: GF activation produced takeoff rates of greater than 90%
mapping_basis: GF is a listed literature synonym of DNp01 (synonyms.csv), and the paper also labels it DNp01; SS00727 -> DNp01 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: four 624-nm LEDs, total irradiance 500 W m-2; 50-ms photostimulation for posture analysis; one stimulus per fly; in the dark
sensory_condition: unrestrained fly on 5 x 5 mm glass platform (FlyPEZ), dark, 6,000 fps high-speed video
coordination_notes: short-mode takeoffs (no wing raising before jump)
penetrance: 96.9% takeoff (283/292) vs 4.2% Empty control (Extended Data Fig. 1e source data)
n_flies_note: posture analysis pooled across GF lines (Fig. 1e/f, n = 360 GF)
notes: Takeoff is a single movement, so the legs are coded no (PROTOCOL 3). Fig. 1e: no significant postural shift for GF (ns, Supplementary Table 1). The paper calls its lines 'DN-specific genetic driver lines'. Legs were tracked only over about 100 ms, so rhythmic stepping could not really be assessed. The paper's own LC4 connectivity model of looming responses is not a rhythm or driver score.

title: Synaptic gradients transform object location to action.
source_locator: Main text 'Neural control of looming escape direction'; Fig. 1d-g; Extended Data Fig. 1e; Supplementary Video 2
quote: DNp11 activation drove flies to lean forwards, whereas activation of DNp02 (including combinations of DNp02 and DNp04 or DNp02, DNp04 and DNp06) promoted backward leaning
mapping_basis: The paper's name DNp02 is a MANC type name; SS01053 -> DNp02 in driver_lines.csv.
